tools.name: youtube_search
tools.description: Search YouTube live via SerpAPI. Returns video_results (videos), plus channels, playlists, movies and related searches. Each video result's id is the YouTube video id — feed it as `v` to youtube_video (details, related videos, comments) and to youtube_transcript. `sp` carries SerpAPI filter and next

tools.name: youtube_video
tools.description: Fetch a single YouTube video by id via SerpAPI: details, related videos, comments and replies. `v` is the video id from a youtube_search video_results entry. Page related videos / comments / replies with next_page_token from a prior result.

tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.description: Fetch a YouTube video's transcript via SerpAPI. `v` is the video id from a youtube_search result. Pick a track with language_code (default 'en' — use the video's own language), and optionally title and type ('asr' for auto-generated captions).
